summary: This Phase 3 study compared two different treatments, INS068 and Insulin Glargine, for people with type 2 diabetes mellitus whose blood sugar was not fully controlled by a long-acting insulin. The trial was sponsored by Jiangsu HengRui Medicine Co., Ltd. and involved 423 participants. The main goal was to see how each treatment changed the participants' blood sugar levels over 26 weeks. The study status is Completed.
